results.question: How many tracks are in the catalog?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Track

results.question: How many customers do we have?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer

results.question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

results.question: What is our total revenue across all invoices?
results.predictedSql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice

results.question: What is the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimal places?
results.predictedSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice

results.question: How many customers are from Brazil?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

results.question: How many albums does the artist Iron Maiden have?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS AlbumCount FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

results.question: Which billing country generates the most invoice revenue? Return only the country name.
results.predictedSql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: List the top 3 artists by number of tracks in the catalog. Return artist name and track count.
results.predictedSql: SELECT ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: Which employee supports the most customers? Return their last name only.
results.predictedSql: SELECT e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.LastName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What are the top 3 best-selling genres by number of tracks sold? Return genre name and units sold.
results.predictedSql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, SUM(il.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: What was our total revenue in 2010?
results.predictedSql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue2010 FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

results.question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
results.predictedSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TracksWithNoComposer FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL OR TRIM(Composer) = ''

results.question: Which artists have more than 10 albums? Return artist names.
results.predictedSql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 10 ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC

results.question: Who is our best customer?
results.predictedSql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, CustomerName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 1
